title: Saved audit locations
summary: Added saved Reports audit locations so operators can keep up to 10 reusable audit roots in the WebView and stage one into the existing audit-start request.
reason: Operators need to audit several recurring library locations without retyping paths, while preserving the backend-owned audit launch contract.
behavior_before: Reports > Start Audit exposed a single Library Root field. Operators had to type or paste each audit root manually before starting an audit.
behavior_after: Reports > Start Audit exposes a saved-location selector plus Save Location and Remove Saved controls. The WebView persists up to 10 local saved roots, stages the selected root into the existing Library Root field, and still submits only the existing single library_root payload to /api/audit/start.
tests_added: Extended tests.python.desktop.test_reports_view_static to cover Reports audit saved-location controls and guardrails.
Extended tests.webview.test_webview_browser_maintenance_reports_smoke to exercise saving, selecting, removing, and capping audit locations without extra audit-start posts.
